skills.name: caveman
skills.purpose: Terse 'caveman' answer style: answer first, no ceremony or hedging, short words, one idea per sentence, while code, commands, paths, numbers and negations stay verbatim. Cuts output tokens without dropping technical facts.
skills.how_to_use: Install with `npx skills add JuliusBrussee/caveman` or the Claude Code plugin (`claude plugin marketplace add JuliusBrussee/caveman`). Trigger with /caveman, 'be brief' or 'less tokens'; stays on until 'stop caveman'. /caveman ultra switches to the harder ultracave mode.
skills.evidence: Also ranked in claude_meta. skills.sh 556K installs, trending #88 (ultracave/megacave hot #5/#6 this week); README cites #1 GitHub Trending (Jul 2026); listed in hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code. Outside tests cited in README: JetBrains paired A/B (86 tasks, skill only) 8.5% fewer output tokens with no quality change; Adobe Research CAVEWOMAN paper 1.4-2.4x lower output cost.
skills.notes: Gains are modest in agentic coding (most tokens are input/tool output, which the skill does not touch). The skill folder itself is prompt-only. The repo's separate caveman CLI/proxy (driven by caveman-setup/-discover/-learn/-optimize) sends usage telemetry by default (opt out: `caveman telemetry off` or DO_NOT_TRACK=1), 'managed mode' tags requests with repo and branch for Caveman Cloud, and the README offers a curl | bash installer. Take the skill, not the engine.

skills.name: caveman-compress
skills.purpose: Rewrites memory files (CLAUDE.md, todo lists, preference notes) into compressed caveman prose to cut the input tokens they cost on every turn, keeping code, URLs, paths, commands and headings exact and saving a readable backup outside the tree.
skills.how_to_use: /caveman-compress <file>. Runs the bundled Python CLI (`python3 -m scripts <path>`), which calls Claude through the Anthropic SDK when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, otherwise `claude --print`; validates the output and retries up to twice.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 385.6K installs, trending #109 this week; same 109k-star repo as caveman.
skills.notes: Sends the file to Anthropic (official API or Claude CLI) only. Review the compressed file: terse rules can lose nuance; the README's own figures are byte sizes, not measured billing savings.

skills.name: cavecrew
skills.purpose: Decides when to delegate to three compressed-output subagents (investigator: locate code, builder: 1-2 file edits, reviewer: diff review) instead of working inline or using Explore, so each delegation returns about a third of the tokens to the main context.
skills.how_to_use: Ships with the caveman plugin, which also installs the cavecrew-investigator/-builder/-reviewer agent files. Triggers when choosing a subagent for search, small edits or review; use vanilla Explore when you want prose and rationale.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 333.6K installs, trending #116 this week; same repo as caveman.
skills.notes: Needs the agents/ files from the plugin; the skill alone does nothing. Same CLI telemetry caveat as caveman applies only if you install the caveman CLI.

skills.name: context-budget
skills.purpose: Audits what a Claude Code session loads every turn (agents, skills, rules, MCP servers and their tool schemas, CLAUDE.md) with token estimates, flags bloat such as >20-tool MCP servers, long descriptions and duplicate copies, and gives a ranked list of token savings.
skills.how_to_use: Run /context-budget or ask why context feels tight after adding skills/MCP servers. Read-only; estimates tokens as words x 1.3 and about 500 tokens per MCP tool.
skills.evidence: everything-claude-code (ECC), 272k stars; skills.sh 9.1K installs; ECC listed in hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code.
skills.notes: Token counts are heuristics, not tokenizer counts; check against /context.

skills.name: strategic-compact
skills.purpose: Suggests manual /compact at logical phase boundaries (after research, before implementation, after a milestone) instead of letting auto-compaction cut mid-task; covers what survives compaction and trigger-table lazy loading to keep context lean.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers in long sessions near context limits; optional PreToolUse hook counts tool calls and nudges at a threshold. Pair with /clear between unrelated tasks.
skills.evidence: Also ranked in claude_meta. ECC 272k stars; skills.sh 10.6K installs; also on aitmpl.com as cc-skill-strategic-compact.
skills.notes: The hook is optional and local.

skills.name: cost-aware-llm-pipeline
skills.purpose: Patterns for cutting LLM API spend in apps: route by task complexity (cheap model first, strong model for hard items), immutable per-call cost tracking with a budget guard, retry only on transient errors, and prompt caching for long system prompts.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when building or reviewing code that calls Claude/OpenAI APIs, batch-processing items, or when spend has to come down. Python examples; adapt model IDs and prices to current ones.
skills.evidence: ECC 272k stars; skills.sh 9.5K installs; copied into several forks (everything-claude-code-zh, skills-for-open-code).
skills.notes: Hard-coded model names and thresholds are examples; check current pricing.

skills.name: context-mode
skills.purpose: Keeps large tool output out of the context window: commands, logs, test output, API responses, browser snapshots and fetched docs run in a sandbox (ctx_execute / ctx_execute_file) or get indexed and searched (ctx_fetch_and_index / ctx_search), so only the relevant lines come back.
skills.how_to_use: Install the context-mode MCP server/plugin for Claude Code (also Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini). The skill tells the agent to use ctx_* tools for anything beyond a small Bash whitelist; /context-mode:ctx-stats shows savings.
skills.evidence: 25k stars since Feb 2026; skills.sh 2.7K installs (ctx-stats 1.6K, ctx-doctor 1.4K); named in the caveman and token-optimizer comparison tables.
skills.notes: Elastic License 2.0 (source-available, not OSI): link-only. README says no telemetry and everything stays local; the sibling ctx-insight skill only opens a hosted team dashboard.

skills.name: context-optimization
skills.purpose: Context-efficiency techniques for agents: compaction strategies, observation masking (drop stale tool output), KV-cache-friendly prompt layout (stable content first), context partitioning across subagents, and budget management with performance targets.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when token cost or context limits hurt quality in an agent design; pairs with the same repo's context-compression, context-degradation and context-fundamentals skills.
skills.evidence: Also ranked in claude_meta. 18k-star collection; in VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills; collection bundle 4K installs on skills.sh.
skills.notes: Conceptual; no scripts.

skills.name: llm-cost-optimizer
skills.purpose: Cost engineering for LLM features in three modes (audit, optimize, design): model routing, prompt caching, output-length control, prompt compression, semantic caching and batching, each with expected savings, plus proactive flags like an unset max_tokens or a single model for every request.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'AI costs too high', 'which model should I use', 'implement prompt caching' or when an AI endpoint is being designed. Asks for traffic, models and spend first, then produces a ranked plan.
skills.evidence: 27k-star collection; skills.sh 80 installs (plus a borghei fork with 87).
skills.notes: Savings percentages are rules of thumb.

skills.name: prompt-caching
skills.purpose: LLM caching patterns: Anthropic cache_control on stable prefixes with cache-read/write monitoring, exact and semantic response caching (Redis), temperature-aware keys, cache-augmented generation (CAG) instead of RAG for small corpora, and invalidation pitfalls.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on prompt caching, response caching or CAG. TypeScript examples with @anthropic-ai/sdk and ioredis/Upstash.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 914 installs (plus 446 for the davila7/claude-code-templates copy, also on aitmpl.com); 47k-star collection.
skills.notes: Converted from vibeship-spawner-skills (Apache-2.0); example model IDs are dated. For diagnosing misses, see audit-prompt-caching.

skills.name: stay-within-limits
skills.purpose: Keeps long-running or parallel agent work inside the 5-hour and weekly plan limits: run bounded waves (default 3 subagents), check usage between waves, pause at 95% and schedule a self-contained resume, re-checking the real window on wake.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers for long or fan-out runs. In Claude Code it reads usage with `npx -y ccusage@latest blocks --active --json`; uses a wakeup/resume tool when the host has one.
skills.evidence: Builder.io's skills repo, created Jun 2026 and at 4.5k stars; skills.sh 304 installs.
skills.notes: npx fetches ccusage from npm on each run; pin a version if that matters. ccusage reads local logs only.

skills.name: efficient-fable
skills.purpose: Uses the top model (Claude Fable) only as orchestrator and judge, and pushes token-heavy research, inventory, test runs and bounded edits to cheaper subagents with tight handoff packets that ask for concise evidence (files, lines, diffs, stop conditions).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on codebase-heavy or token-heavy work with Fable; the pattern applies to any expensive lead model. Needs subagents with a model override.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 833 installs; Builder.io repo created Jun 2026, 4.5k stars.

skills.name: token-optimizer
skills.purpose: Audits a Claude Code or Codex setup for 'ghost tokens' (unused skills, MCP servers, oversized CLAUDE.md and memory, autocompact settings), applies fixes and measures before/after context savings with local SQLite; target 5-15% recovered context, more with autocompact tuning.
skills.how_to_use: Install the token-optimizer plugin; run /token-optimizer when context feels tight. Siblings: token-coach, token-dashboard, fleet-auditor, resume-checkpoint.
skills.evidence: 2.5k stars; skills.sh 876 installs (token-coach 353, fleet-auditor 333).
skills.notes: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (plus a small-business permission): link-only. README states zero telemetry and no network calls. The skill tells the agent never to suggest removing its own skills.

skills.name: rtk-optimizer
skills.purpose: Wraps verbose shell commands (git log/status/diff, find, cat, test runners, cargo, pnpm) with RTK so their output is compressed 50-90% before it enters the context window, and tracks savings over the session.
skills.how_to_use: Needs the RTK CLI (`brew install rtk-ai/tap/rtk` or `cargo install rtk`). Triggers on high-verbosity commands; suggests the rtk-prefixed form and runs it once confirmed.
skills.evidence: Example skill in the 6.1k-star Claude Code Ultimate Guide; skills.sh 255 installs; RTK itself (rtk-ai/rtk) has 82k stars.
skills.notes: RTK's telemetry is opt-in and off by default (RTK_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 blocks it); its README's curl | sh installer is avoidable via brew/cargo. CC-BY-SA requires attribution and share-alike.

skills.name: claude-usage-analyst
skills.purpose: Evidence-based explanation of Claude Code/Desktop token usage and cost from ccusage data: quota burn, 5-hour blocks, model mix (e.g. Fable vs Opus), cache read/write share, separating observed numbers from interpretation.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke explicitly (model invocation disabled). Needs ccusage (`npx ccusage@latest`); runs the bundled analyze_claude_usage.py for a date range and timezone.
skills.evidence: 1.4k-star collection; skills.sh 353 installs; ccusage (18.9k stars) is the usual Claude Code usage tool and is in hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code.
skills.notes: Local only: the script shells out to ccusage.

skills.name: redis-semantic-cache
skills.purpose: Semantic caching of LLM responses with Redis LangCache: cache-aside flow (search, then call the model on a miss and store), similarity-threshold tuning for hit rate vs precision, separate caches per task type, and attribute filters.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when caching completions or RAG answers to cut API cost and latency. Needs a Redis Cloud LangCache instance (HOST, CACHE_ID, API_KEY) and the langcache SDK or REST API.
skills.evidence: Official Redis; skills.sh 1.7K installs; redis/agent-skills listed in VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills.
skills.notes: LangCache is a preview Redis Cloud service: prompts and responses are stored there (vendor's own service). Self-hosted alternative: Redis vector search.

skills.name: exploring-llm-costs
skills.purpose: Investigates LLM spend in PostHog LLM analytics: total cost over time, cost by model, provider, user, trace or custom property, token and cache-hit economics, cost regressions, and turning results into dashboards and alerts.
skills.how_to_use: Needs PostHog LLM analytics ($ai_generation events) and the PostHog MCP tools (query-trends, execute-sql, llm traces). Triggers on 'how much are we spending on LLMs' or a trace URL.
skills.evidence: Official PostHog; skills.sh 342 installs.
skills.notes: Measures cost per user/feature/trace; it does not reduce cost by itself.

skills.name: chisle
skills.purpose: Always-on efficiency mode on three axes: terse prose (no headings or tables the question didn't ask for), a YAGNI 'efficiency ladder' for code (skip, reuse, stdlib, native, existing dep, one line, then minimum code), and lean tool use and reasoning.
skills.how_to_use: Trigger with /chisle, 'chisle mode' or 'be efficient'; off with 'stop chisle'. Siblings chisle-audit and chisle-review check existing code. Install via `npx chisle` or the plugin.
skills.evidence: New repo (30 Jun 2026) already at 594 stars; skills.sh 95 installs.
skills.notes: README also offers a curl | bash installer; prefer npx/plugin. Overlaps caveman (prose) and ponytail (code, ranked in coding_practices).

skills.name: tare
skills.purpose: Diagnoses why a 5-hour or weekly Claude Code limit was hit: parses local session logs to show which model, project, tool, MCP server, skill or subagent used the tokens, cache-read share, background usage, API-equivalent cost, week-over-week comparisons and a redacted shareable summary.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on any usage-limit complaint or 'where did my tokens go'. Runs bundled Python scripts (ccaudit.py, ccreport.py, forensics.py) over ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl; HTML/CSV export.
skills.evidence: New repo (12 Aug 2026), 293 stars; skills.sh 317 installs.
skills.notes: Local only; the skill says never to upload results unless asked.

skills.name: audit-prompt-caching
skills.purpose: Diagnoses prompt/prefix-cache misses as request-path problems across providers (Anthropic cache_control, OpenAI prompt_cache_key, Gemini, Bedrock, vLLM/SGLang KV reuse): prefix stability, tool/schema ordering, effort or model changes that break the cache, usage-field telemetry and cache ROI.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on cached_tokens=0, cache_read_input_tokens=0, rising input cost or TTFT, or changes to prompts, tools, schemas or routers. Bundled Python scripts (usage-log analysis, layout linter, prefix stability check, ROI estimate) run locally.
skills.evidence: 123 stars; skills.sh 85 installs. Most thorough caching skill found (27 KB plus scripts and per-provider references).
skills.notes: Scripts checked: no network imports.
